scope: Targeted primary-source synthesis for archived Steer trajectories, rare high-affinity paths and coordinate guidance; not an exhaustive systematic review

sources.title: Mitigating Premature Exploitation in Particle-based Monte Carlo for Inference-Time Scaling
sources.status: Peer-reviewed conference paper; arXiv first submitted in 2025
sources.verified_finding: Entropic annealing changes resampling temperature based on diversity; one-step look-ahead modulation evaluates a successor to mitigate myopic particle selection.
sources.project_proposal: Use archived successor and terminal outcomes for offline look-ahead, plus genealogy and geometry-mode coverage; avoid extra online model calls.
limits: Results concern LLM mathematical reasoning, not ligand affinity
LaM adds one extra forward pass
Local weight ESS does not by itself diagnose cumulative root loss in current data
Better search cannot repair a systematically inaccurate reward

sources.title: Practical and Asymptotically Exact Conditional Sampling in Diffusion Models
sources.verified_finding: Optimal twisting uses the likelihood of a future terminal condition given an intermediate state. Practical denoised-estimate twisting requires nontrivial importance corrections for SMC consistency.
sources.project_proposal: Replace instantaneous-score-only evidence with policy-specific future elite potential.
limits: Diffusion and Riemannian diffusion examples do not establish FLOWR affinity results
No-resampling approximate gradient guidance does not inherit asymptotic exactness
An endpoint point estimate can miss multimodal future outcomes

sources.title: A General Framework for Inference-time Scaling and Steering of Diffusion Models
sources.verified_finding: Intermediate potentials redistribute particles toward terminal rewards; different potential histories affect performance and diversity. Difference potentials may undervalue trajectories already at a high-reward plateau.
sources.project_proposal: Provide absolute future value separately from its time derivative; do not prune high-value plateau modes from the prior library.
limits: Max-potential results do not prove max is best for this target
Resampling and terminal importance correction differ from the allowed GG protocol
No demonstrated CK2/CLK3 performance transfer

sources.title: Data-driven methods to estimate the committor function in conceptual ocean models
read_regions: Discussion of complexity and estimation limitations
sources.verified_finding: A Markov chain built from nearest historical states and their successors can estimate committors via a sparse transition matrix, without a trained neural predictor.
sources.project_proposal: Use same-clock native edges to construct a nonstationary finite-horizon graph and backward value recursion; smoothly extend values using coordinate kernels.
limits: Original setting is physical ocean dynamics, not generative algorithm time
FLOWR projected coordinate features need not be Markov-complete
High-dimensional sparse coverage can impair accuracy
Steer-future descendants are not labels for native continuation probability

sources.title: The weighted ensemble path sampling method is statistically exact for a broad class of stochastic processes and binning procedures
sources.status: Peer-reviewed journal article; earlier arXiv preprint in 2008
sources.verified_finding: Appropriate weighted splitting and merging of trajectories can preserve process statistics across a broad class of processes and binning choices.
sources.project_proposal: Keep rare geometry-path regions in an offline archive; preserve lineage and weighting metadata instead of letting clone counts dominate evidence.
limits: Family balancing is not a proof of unbiased importance weighting
Using WE ideas offline is not executing the original algorithm
Unknown future outcomes cannot be recovered by reweighting observed descendants alone

sources.title: Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites
sources.verified_finding: MAP-Elites keeps high-performing solutions across different low-dimensional feature niches rather than returning only a single global winner.
sources.project_proposal: Archive terminal elite paths across data-supported coordinate trajectory modes; retain intact representatives and independent-family coverage.
limits: The HTML-rendered cover has a later rendering date; bibliography uses original submission date
A 255-dimensional grid would be impractical
Archived-data regrouping does not itself discover unseen chemistry or execute mutation/crossover search

sources.title: On the Guidance of Flow Matching
read_regions: Section 3.1 general guidance and coupling assumptions
sources.verified_finding: General flow guidance depends on conditional endpoint/coupling distributions. Gradient methods appear under local and path assumptions, with endpoint covariance relevant to approximation.
sources.project_proposal: Treat the current endpoint-VJP reward as an approximate control; preserve multiple future modes and consider data-supported anisotropic geometry.
limits: The diffusion h-transform is not automatically an exact ODE guidance formula
FLOWR includes discrete variables and self-conditioning not captured by coordinate-only state projection
Learned mode covariance is not automatically the true conditional endpoint covariance

sources.title: Feynman-Kac-Flow: Inference Steering of Conditional Flow Matching to an Energy-Tilted Posterior
sources.verified_finding: The paper adapts Feynman-Kac steering to conditional flow matching, addresses deterministic path loss using a stochastic process and studies mode isolation and stereochemical transition-state generation.
sources.project_proposal: Audit whether copied paths actually diversify; reuse already-computed flow forecasts as geometry features without new affinity evaluations.
limits: The algorithm includes resampling and stochastic-process changes
Generating stereochemically correct transition states is not binding-affinity optimization
Its tilted-distribution guarantees cannot be claimed for the proposed no-Steer kernel reward
